_note: Asset metadata, keyed by the number in the filename — the same addressing as manifest.json, so renaming a file keeps its record. Hand-edit freely, or use the panel: select an image, and the `asset N · metadata` group edits the record for whatever art it is currently showing. The panel's `save metadata` button writes this file (loopback only).
_provenance: title / artist / year / medium / source / note are free-form. A textbox with `metaFrom` and `template` fills {title}, {artist}, … from here — and because it reads whatever the image's CURRENT src is, the card follows a `srcs` series as you cycle it with ']'.
_face: The `face` box is written by the panel's `scan face` button and read by `align: "face"` art. x/y/w/h are the face-oval bounding box as fractions of the IMAGE's own width and height; roll is degrees. Image space, never stage space — the record travels with the art.
